0.date: Spring sunset, on the evening before ch. 1
0.summary: The thirty-three-year-old novelist [[alvaro-da-silva|Alvaro Flores da Silva]] introduces himself: four novels, a silver [[braslet|bracelet]] as a master of art, and a dream of inscribing his name on the [[svitok|Scroll]] as his grandfather [[rikardo-flores|Ricardo]] did. He walks through Laerta at sunset with [[fernan-gerejra|Fernan]] and [[lyusil|Lucille Gereira]], who outline their political reforms. Alvaro announces that from here on he will speak of himself in the third person.

1.date: Spring; evening and the next day at 3 p.m.
1.summary: At an expensive restaurant, master of law [[vinsente-ramires|Vincente Ramires da Rimini]] calls Fernan and Lucille obreros unworthy of the place. [[alvaro-da-silva|Alvaro]] challenges him to a duel; Ramires proposes a [[duelnyj-spor|duel debate]]. Alvaro loses at the [[palata-slova]] the next day and must pay seven thousand escudos.

2.date: Autumn; about a month after Plyutva falls
2.place: A bare hill near a railway halt and the ruins of a farm behind the lines in [[ollandiya]]
2.summary: Lieutenant [[ditrikh|Dietrich von Dort]] inspects the enslaved “stones” of a Dangarian battery and speaks with the blessed man [[spasenie|Salvation]] and Neubiy. The stones flee at night after maiming Corporal [[gelb|Gelb]]. Ollandian hussars attack in the morning. After looking into the well, Dietrich takes command when Staff Captain [[zejdvist|Zeidvist]] dies, defeats the hussars with three volleys of grapeshot, and kills Salvation.

3.date: Within three days of losing the debate; day and evening
3.place: The [[akademiya-iskusstv]], a bank, and the [[grand-opera]] in [[laerta]]
3.summary: [[alvaro-da-silva|Alvaro]] lectures on protagonists, meets the blond reformist Wasp, and learns he has only 4,600 escudos. Backstage at Señorita Violet, [[filippe|Don Filippe di Berro]] commissions a book on four (later five) heroes of the Solantian Expedition and offers to cover the debt and pay another three thousand.

4.date: Late autumn and first snow; nine months into the year the doctor gave Red
4.place: An enslaved settlement deep in [[dangar]] and [[joriksen|Joriksen’s]] house
4.summary: The narrator follows the rail line from [[kataliya]] through [[ollandiya]] and [[mergana]] into [[dangar]], where the third protagonist, [[red|Red]], is enslaved. He stands up to the foreman, digs what he thinks is his grave, and learns from [[joriksen|Fritjof Joriksen]] that a well could earn him his freedom. Terminally ill, Red demands that his letter be sent to [[laerta]] first.

5.date: The day after ch. 3; evening, then morning and a lecture at three
5.place: [[laerta]]: the [[tri-byka|Three Bulls]] tavern, [[khuanes|Juanes’s]] house, and the Academy
5.summary: [[alvaro-da-silva|Alvaro]] tells his friends about [[filippe|Filippe’s]] commission; [[fernan-gerejra|Fernan]] volunteers as his secretary. They question [[emil|Emil]] and the widow at the home of the recently deceased doctor [[khuanes|Garcia Juanes]]. Alvaro pockets an anonymous note and discusses the death in a lecture on plot openings.

6.date: A day or two after the battle at the halt; Latsen fell three months ago
6.place: [[latsen]]: a summer restaurant in the square, then the town hall
6.summary: [[ditrikh|Dietrich]], recommended for promotion, meets the Ollandian [[olkha|Olkha]] at a restaurant. Major [[klyajn|Wolfgang von Klein]] tells him he is suspected of treason. Unable to mention the well, his chief defense, Dietrich is suspended and ordered to wait in [[khofshtadt]].

7.date: Daytime, after the obreros’ debate with factory owners at the Chamber of the Word
7.place: [[laerta]]: the waterfront, [[staryj-port|Old Port]], and [[karlos|Carlos el Niña’s]] fort
7.summary: [[fernan-gerejra|Fernan]] tries to show Alvaro the world’s injustices, but Alvaro takes him to the smuggler [[karlos|Carlos el Niña]], the first subject of the book. They endure a cruel pistol prank and meet the ailing [[izabel|Doña Isabel]]. In the cellar Carlos shows them a newly unearthed [[kolodets|well]] with a giant chrysanthemum, entwined in a vine, wilting at its bottom.

8.date: Winter; the first weeks of captivity, with the pit a yard and a half deep
8.place: [[joriksen|Joriksen’s]] enslaved settlement: the crew’s dugout, a clearing, and a wooden church
8.summary: [[red|Red]] digs the well and endures abuse from the foreman and his men. At a service where free people feed porridge to enslaved people, he refuses food from another’s hand and catches the [[klyajn|Black Falcon’s]] eye. After a beating in the forest, he takes on the crew and establishes an equal division of food.

9.date: The morning after visiting Carlos, then the day’s journey and the night
9.summary: [[beatris|Beatriz]] drives Alvaro and [[fernan-gerejra|Fernan]] to General [[dezerej|Deserey]] at [[ortiyar]]. He critiques Alvaro’s battle scenes, demonstrates grapeshot, and asks him to make fear of [[dangar]] the book’s theme. On the way back Alvaro realizes Deserey lied about his last visit to [[khuanes|Juanes]]; a green steam carriage follows them.

10.date: Late summer, in Gehai; a month’s journey after dismissal
10.place: [[khofshtadt]]: the Witwen district and the von Dorts’ apartment
10.summary: [[ditrikh|Dietrich]] returns to his wife [[mari|Marie]] and son [[khajnts|Heinz]]. His letter never reached Marie, and they are nearly out of money. After a fruitless job search and an argument, he gives most of their savings to [[gizeke|Frau Gizeke]] for a ticket to Baroness [[elza|Walbrecht’s]] fishing.

11.date: The day after the journey to Ortiyar
11.place: An inn on the road from [[ortiyar]]; [[laerta]]: the servants’ district, the station, and Foucault Street
11.summary: [[alvaro-da-silva|Alvaro]] and [[fernan-gerejra|Fernan]] mistake chauffeur [[ugo-martines|Hugo Martines]] for a spy. Alvaro drives [[beatris|Beatriz]] away by writing to her father. In Laerta he witnesses a protest of dismissed [[obrero|obreros]] dispersed with blank cannon fire and comes home to a gruesome gift in his notebook.

12.date: Winter; several months later, with the well twelve to thirteen yards deep
12.place: [[joriksen|Joriksen’s]] settlement: the dugout, the church, the women’s farm, and the forest
12.summary: [[red|Red]] reaches water and expects to be freed the next day. Instead, [[yakka|Yakka]] takes him to the women’s farm for a night with [[greta|Greta]]. Realizing this is his reward in place of freedom, Red strikes Yakka, takes his gun, and flees.

13.date: Several days after finding the finger; a three-day drinking bout
13.place: [[laerta]]: the Arts district, the factory district, and [[kristobal-maduro|Maduro’s]] estate
13.summary: [[alvaro-da-silva|Alvaro]] gives a listless lecture on flawed protagonists. Constable [[diego-ingres|Ingres]] tells him the severed finger in his desk is no grounds for a suit. He writes to [[filippe|Filippe]] to give up the book. [[fernan-gerejra|Fernan]] makes him visit Maduro, where [[salvador|Salvador]] questions him and Alvaro outlines his own plan to reform the Esfera of Production.

14.date: Summer; the day of the fishing, the last day of Gehai
14.place: [[khofshtadt]]: Baroness [[elza|Walbrecht’s]] mansion and its schönbrun; the von Dort home
14.summary: [[ditrikh|Dietrich]] secretly spends 200 marks from the family’s stash on the fishing, run by [[joriksen|Fritjof Joriksen]] at the baroness’s [[kolodets|schönbrun]]. He sees [[olkha|Olkha]] with her uncle Prince [[lents|Lenz]], tells Joriksen about his own schönbrun, and receives an invitation. He confesses to [[mari|Marie]] that evening.

15.date: Winter; a few days after the escape
15.place: The enslaved settlement: dugouts, the women’s farm, and the gravestone
15.summary: [[yakka|Yakka]] tracks a freezing [[red|Red]] and brings him back. Baron [[landau|Landau]] wants to execute him, but [[joriksen|Joriksen]] explains that Red must dig a schönbrun. Red is given a dugout of his own and works at night by a fire. He sings Catalian songs, [[greta|Greta]] carries his letter home, and he realizes Joriksen has recreated Catalian surroundings for him.

16.date: The day of the exhibition; the stranger arranges a meeting for 7 p.m. two days later
16.place: The [[galereya-eliste|Eliste Gallery]] and [[khose-flarbo|Jose Flarbo’s]] bookshop in [[laerta]]
16.summary: [[filippe|Filippe]] calls [[alvaro-da-silva|Alvaro]] to the [[filosofiya-uzhasa|Philosophy of Horror]] exhibition, demands that he write the book, and shows him a newspaper item about a fight at the station. At Flarbo’s shop Alvaro learns the story of the deranged philosopher [[liess-van-khalm|van Halm]] and arranges to meet a clever stranger.

17.date: Saturday at five in the afternoon and that evening; autumn
17.place: [[khofshtadt]]: the Astoria hotel, [[lurd|Count von Lourd’s]] house in Schlüssel, and Witwenplatz
17.summary: At [[olkha|Olkha’s]] request, [[ditrikh|Dietrich]] poses as a cousin of her friend [[katrina|Katrina von Eyring]], Count [[lurd|Ludwig von Lourd’s]] wife. Over dinner the count explains world politics and the situation in [[dangar]]. The evening ends in a kiss in the carriage and an argument at home: [[mari|Marie]] refuses to let him in.

18.date: The morning after the meeting at the shop, then the day and evening
18.place: [[laerta]]: the [[staryj-port|Old Port]] and [[karlos|Carlos el Niña’s]] fort
18.summary: [[alvaro-da-silva|Alvaro]] asks [[karlos|Carlos]] about [[khuanes|Juanes’s]] death and finds him distraught over [[izabel|Doña Isabel’s]] disappearance. After a reckless revolver game, the friends get drunk. Alvaro hears about the sailor da Vira and learns that Juanes talked too much. On the way back a stranger shoots Alvaro through the palm and tells him not to write.

19.date: Winter thaw; from the third yard of the dig to the water
19.place: The enslaved settlement and surrounding forest in [[dangar]]
19.summary: [[red|Red]] notices he is being watched and that his letter has gone missing; it is then returned. [[landau|Landau]] shows him a camp where hundreds of enslaved people dig in vain for wells. Red reaches water in the thaw and realizes his cough is gone, but the [[brigadir|foreman]] buries him in the pit.

20.date: The night and day after Alvaro is shot
20.summary: Friends tend to [[alvaro-da-silva|Alvaro]] at the Three Bulls. [[mor|Mor]], chief engineer at [[esperantsa|Esperanza]], explains the reformists’ aims and asks him to influence [[fatima|Allen Fatima]]. Feeling used, Alvaro storms out. [[beatris|Beatriz]] picks him up; they reconcile, and he takes her on as a student and assistant.

21.date: The morning after the visit to the Lourds in ch. 17; by three o’clock
21.place: [[khofshtadt]]: [[gizeke|Frau Gizeke’s]] apartment, [[joriksen|Joriksen’s]] mansion, and the hotel
21.summary: Sober again and short of money and land, [[ditrikh|Dietrich]] goes to [[joriksen|Joriksen]], who demands [[khajnts|Heinz]] as collateral. Dietrich leaves, finds Prince [[lents|Lenz]] listed in the guild’s atlas as owner of the land with the schönbrun, and returns with a different contract.

22.date: The day before Alvaro’s lecture; six months before the election for supremo
22.place: The road out of [[laerta]] and back; the [[svitok|Great Scroll]]
22.summary: Driving an [[esperantsa|Esperanza]] car, [[alvaro-da-silva|Alvaro]] and [[beatris|Beatriz]] theorize that their adversaries are a Dangarian spy and [[fatima|Fatima’s]] aggrieved son. In the [[svitok|Scroll’s]] archive Alvaro pieces together the story of Rodrigo da Vira and [[karmensita-estevos|Carmencita Estevos]], but Beatriz finds only a daughter of Fatima named Unoco.

23.date: Spring; just after the well collapses, followed by about a month of recovery
23.place: [[dunkvald]] and the women’s settlement of Katzen
23.summary: Lieutenant [[klyajn|Klein]] argues with Baron [[landau|Landau]], who demonstrates the power of an oberfischmeister. [[red|Red]] recovers in [[greta|Greta’s]] home, debates the Sower with an enslaved temple servant, and digs out the well again on the baron’s orders. When he reaches water, Landau declares that it is no [[kolodets|schönbrun]].

24.date: The evening of the second meeting with the stranger and the next day
24.place: The hospital’s anatomy theater, [[khuanes|Juanes’s]] house, and [[laerta]]
24.summary: The stranger takes [[alvaro-da-silva|Alvaro]] to an autopsy. He flees the theater but realizes how [[khuanes|Doctor Juanes]] died. The following day he and [[beatris|Beatriz]] establish that [[emil|Emil]] gave the doctor the wrong medicine. Beatriz gets him to talk about [[liess-van-khalm|van Halm]], who saw the heroes of Solanta in the well.

25.date: Autumn; ten days before the train leaves for Ollandia
25.place: Dietrich’s hotel and Baroness [[elza|Walbrecht’s]] mansion in [[khofshtadt]]
25.summary: [[ditrikh|Dietrich]] keeps the mortgage details from [[mari|Marie]], misses [[olkha|Olkha]], and turns up uninvited at the baroness’s. In Olkha’s bedroom [[katrina|Katrina]] stages a scene. Prince [[lents|Lenz]] demands a duel, and Count [[lurd|von Lourd]] offers a “solution.”

26.date: The day after the autopsy and the discovery about Emil; a meeting at 10 p.m.
26.place: The Mercy Clinic and a passage to a wine cellar on North Rampart Street in [[laerta]]
26.summary: [[alvaro-da-silva|Alvaro]] and [[beatris|Beatriz]] visit the deranged [[liess-van-khalm|van Halm]], who recognizes the names of the Solanta heroes and fears [[eliga|Eliga]]. That evening the stranger explains the election to Alvaro in a secret cellar. She takes revenge for the autopsy that night, then comes back for him.

27.date: Spring; at night, a month after the cave-in
27.place: [[dunkvald]]: a dugout used as a cell, the forest, the road, and the gravestone
27.summary: [[klyajn|Klein]] tells the captive [[red|Red]] that the well was ordinary and that [[joriksen|Joriksen]] devised the scheme and left. Red cuts his bonds with Klein’s knife, kills the escort, sacks the convoy, and lets a young clerk go. At the gravestone, Baron [[landau|Landau]] stops him with his power.

28.date: The morning after the night with the stranger; six months after Ollandia capitulates
28.summary: [[alvaro-da-silva|Alvaro]] overhears the stranger with General [[dezerej|Deserey]]. She is [[fatima|Fatima Ir-Reya]], chief allen of Law, and the general wants her to secure mobilization. Alvaro accuses her of deceiving him and quarrels with her and then with her daughter [[beatris|Beatriz]], who concealed their relationship.

29.date: The night and morning after the scandal; Dunkwald fell that spring
29.place: [[khofshtadt]]: Baroness [[elza|Walbrecht’s]] house, Witwenplatz, and the station
29.summary: Count [[lurd|von Lourd]] settles the scandal with Prince [[lents|Lenz]] by threatening to label him unsicher and proposing that [[olkha|Olkha]] marry [[ditrikh|Dietrich]]. Dietrich says goodbye to [[mari|Marie]] and leaves for Ollandia with [[joriksen|Joriksen]]. On the train, guild magnus [[amir-sedoj|Amir the Grey]] announces that everyone in [[dunkvald]] died.

30.date: Autumn, soon after the quarrels with Mor and Fatima; train at night
30.place: [[laerta]]: Crafts Square, general headquarters, and the Three Bulls; train to [[seleziya]]
30.summary: A reproachful letter from [[mor|Mor]] tells [[alvaro-da-silva|Alvaro]] that [[fernan-gerejra|Fernan]] spoke to her about Beatriz. He hits Fernan, then makes peace. Alvaro gets a thousand escudos from [[dezerej|Deserey]] on the pretext of tracking a spy. He tells Fernan that [[liess-van-khalm|van Halm]] may have seen the Solanta heroes in a well in Selezia, and they set out.

31.date: Several days in late summer or early autumn
31.place: [[latsen]]: Field Marshal [[rajniger|Reiniger’s]] headquarters and the halt with the [[kolodets|schönbrun]]
31.summary: Major [[klyajn|Klein]] learns that the field marshal is halving [[khofmajer|Hofmeyer’s]] army and hints that he should delay the courier. Klein sends [[joriksen|Joriksen]] to study the dark schönbrun and arrests [[ditrikh|Dietrich]], but releases him under pressure from [[katrina|Katrina]] and [[olkha|Olkha]].

32.date: Three days, starting the morning after the train from Laerta
32.place: [[tres-molinos]] in [[seleziya]]: the House Above, an inn, and a tavern
32.summary: [[alvaro-da-silva|Alvaro]] and [[fernan-gerejra|Fernan]] inspect the cursed House Above, where van Halm lost his mind. They learn he housed six Dangarian “servants.” Alvaro finds [[izabel|Isabel el Niña]] alive in town and demands the truth about Rodrigo da Vira.

33.date: Several years, from the first execution to the spring of roughly the seventh year
33.summary: Chained in the pit, [[red|Red]] becomes the condemned prisoners’ executioner under [[landau|Landau’s]] Zustand. Years pass, [[yakka|Yakka]] and [[klyajn|Klein]] leave, and [[greta|Greta]] admits she betrayed Red before being sent to the pit herself. She is found dead the next morning. Army levy officers take Red on the recommendation of the Kaiser’s Claws.

34.date: The evening of Fernan and Alvaro’s argument; Juanes is already dead
34.place: [[tres-molinos]]: [[posledniaya-zima|Last Winter]] castle and the cellar with the schönbrun
34.summary: At [[liess-van-khalm|van Halm’s]] castle, [[alvaro-da-silva|Alvaro]] solves the mystery of the cursed door. [[salvador|Salvador]] and the second killer capture him, [[fernan-gerejra|Fernan]], and [[beatris|Beatriz]]. In the cellar by the dark schönbrun, Salvador is killed and the other murderer is wounded and captured. [[fatima|Fatima]] arrives and tells what happened between the heroes of Solanta.
